messages:
incident-bot: Paging: p99 latency for router service > 1.6s over the last 3m. Streaming stalls reported. Auto-page sent to #incidents and on-call.
sam (on-call): got it, investigating now. seeing p95 ~420ms p99 ~1.7s across us-west. streaming stall rate spiking on ongoing sessions.
mira (on-call): ack. i’m pulling routing metrics and recent deploys. any customer-impact reports? support-lead?
support-lead: two high-priority tickets from 'Northstar' and 'BlueBox' reporting repeated stalls in live inference streams (clients see spinner, reconnects). ticket ids #5234 #5235. no full errors, mostly stalls.
jordan (infra): nothing in infra alarms except router latency. LB health looks fine. no pod crashloop. CPU/GPU utilization normal.
anna (routing): uploading last 30m of routing decisions snapshot to GCS: gs://redwood-dumps/router/1912345678/snapshot.json
anna (routing): quick hypothesis: a routing policy tweak rolled ~20m ago that introduced heuristics for 'hotkey smoothing' — might be creating hot partitions for certain shard keys in us-west.
leo (sre): can you grep the logs for 'policy=hotkey-smoothing' and show recent decision latencies? paste relevant lines.
anna (routing): here are sample lines:
```
[2026-03-14T04:10:12Z] req=abc123 region=us-west policy=hotkey-smoothing decision_ms=12 route=shard-27
[2026-03-14T04:11:02Z] req=def456 region=us-west policy=hotkey-smoothing decision_ms=2100 route=shard-27
[2026-03-14T04:11:42Z] req=ghi789 region=us-west policy=hotkey-smoothing decision_ms=1850 route=shard-27
```
anna (routing): lines show occasional very high decision_ms when the policy triggers a specific shard remap.
sam (on-call): so router decision path is stalling, not the backend inference? need to confirm kv-cache or routing table lock contention.
kyle (eng-runtime): could be kv cache eviction/rehash on heavy hotkey — that would blow up decision latencies if the routing table does sync ops.
jordan (infra): i’m not seeing elevated db latencies. but we do see a bunch of requests skewed to shard-27 in us-west.
mira (on-call): @anna, can we temporarily revert the hotkey-smoothing heuristic or disable it for us-west only?
anna (routing): yes. we have a per-region flag. running: routerctl set-flag hotkey_smoothing.enabled=false --region=us-west
anna (routing): command issued. will take a few seconds to propagate to edge routers.
incident-bot: config-change: hotkey_smoothing.enabled=false propagated to 12 routers in us-west (id: cfg-1912345678)
sam (on-call): monitoring p95/p99 now…
leo (sre): initial numbers after disable: p95 420ms -> 380ms, p99 1700ms -> 520ms. big improvement at the tail.
support-lead: told Northstar support that we're rolling a config to mitigate; they're seeing fewer stalls on a small subset of sessions.
ops-lead: nice. any risk reverting the flag? rollback strategy?
anna (routing): flag is safe to flip — it's purely heuristic. will keep disabled until we root cause.
kyle (eng-runtime): we'll instrument more detailed traces for decision path and add a sampling hook to catch the slow path requests (trace ids: auto-sampled).
jordan (infra): i'm going to add temporary rate caps to incoming region=us-west to avoid exacerbating hot partitions while we stabilize.
jordan (infra): run: routerctl set-weight region=us-west limit-pps=0.92
anna (routing): weight change applied.
mira (on-call): good. need to notify customers: support already posting updates.
support-lead: posted status update to Northstar and BlueBox: "Mitigation deployed, monitoring. If you still see stalls send logs." they acknowledged.
leo (sre): capturing post-mitigations graphs: p99 back to ~520ms sustained for 5m. streaming stall rate dropped ~88%.
sam (on-call): any evidence this is multi-region? quick check: eu-west p99 140ms, apac 160ms. seems localized to us-west.
anna (routing): digging into why shard-27 got hot: traffic analysis shows many sessions from a single customer pattern (Northstar) had prefix that hashed to shard-27. our smoothing heuristic tried to migrate but the migration logic added lock contention.
kyle (eng-runtime): reproducer plan: run traffic generator with Northstar-like key distribution in staging and enable smoothing to reproduce decision stalls.
ops-lead: for immediate next steps: 1) keep heuristic disabled in us-west 2) keep rate cap for 30min 3) collect traces & sampling logs 4) prepare rollback plan for deploy if needed 5) postmortem owners assigned.
mira (on-call): I'll take lead on the postmortem. @anna and @kyle to co-own root cause and fix. @jordan to validate infra safeguards. @leo to validate SLO impact numbers.
mira (on-call): handing off active on-call to @sam in 10m — will follow up in doc.
sam (on-call): i'll keep watch for 30m and then standby for any rollouts.
anna (routing): note: we found one recent change in routing PR #843 that adjusted the smoothing threshold from 0.6->0.4. reverting that is candidate fix.
kyle (eng-runtime): we'll also add mutex-free path to decision logic to avoid blocking on shard metadata refresh.
support-lead: customers updated; no new high-severity tickets in the last 12m.
leo (sre): provisional severity: Sev2 (SLO breach affecting subset of customers with streaming stalls). will confirm in postmortem.
jordan (infra): removing the temporary rate cap in 30m if metrics stay stable.
ops-lead: good work team. please add timeline and config diffs to the incident doc. assign severity and link support tickets.
mira (on-call): creating incident doc now: https://confluence.internal/incident/1912345678
sam (on-call): ack. will post final handoff when i step out.
anna (routing): FYI left the old config snapshot at gs://redwood-dumps/router/1912345678/old_config.json
incident-bot: Incident resolved for paging rule after mitigation: p99 trending below 600ms for 15m (auto-note). Keep monitoring.
mira (on-call): closing the active page; continuing investigation in follow-up doc. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
sam (on-call): thanks team. follow-up actions: postmortem in 48h, fix PR + canary tests for heuristic, add region-specific circuit-breakers.
kyle (eng-runtime): adding a unit/integration test to ensure smoothing heuristic doesn't introduce blocking path.
leo (sre): will verify SLO calc and update ops dashboard thresholds as needed.
support-lead: I'll reach out to Northstar and BlueBox for confirmation and offer a 1:1 tech sync.
ops-lead: moving to post-incident review channel after 30m. great job on mitigation and customer comms.
